name: K-Dominant Character
description: You are given a string s consisting of lowercase Latin letters. Character c is called k -dominant iff each substring of s with length at least k contains this character c . You have to find minimum k such that there exists at least one k -dominant character.
input_specification: The first line contains string s consisting of lowercase Latin letters ( 1 ≤ | s | ≤ 100000 ).
output_specification: Print one number — the minimum value of k such that there exists at least one k -dominant character.
approach_summary: Exploit monotonicity of two-pointer invariant [L, R]. Advance R while shifting L forward to maintain validity, running in O(N) amortized time.
